title: RBC Raises Alphabet (GOOGL) Target on AI Advertising Momentum
text: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) is one of the AI Stocks Analysts Are Watching Closely. On January 15, RBC Capital analyst Brad Erickson raised the price target on the stock to $375.00 (from $315.00) while maintaining an “Outperform” rating.
